lead.title: Voter registration closes today
lead.summary: Mailed applications need an October 5-or-earlier postmark for the November 3 election. Request a manual postmark at the postal counter; mailbox pickup may be too late.
lead.detail: October 5 only: the Nelda Wells Spears Building, 2433 Ridgepoint Drive, accepts registration from 8 a.m. to midnight. Other county offices have different hours.

access.title: Zilker access this week
access.summary: The City lists the pool, trail and Greenbelt as open, while multiple park parking lots stay closed through October 18. A posted road-closure endpoint is not confirmation of reopening.
access.detail: The next Barton Springs Road closure is scheduled for Thursday, October 8, at 7 p.m. The sources checked do not confirm a Great Lawn reopening date.

developments.title: Flying today? Leave time before departure
developments.summary: The airport expects a busy Monday and recommends arriving at least 2.5 hours before domestic flights or 3 hours before international flights, plus time for bags or rental-car returns.

developments.title: Municipal Court changes its docket schedule
developments.summary: Effective today, attorney appearance dockets and jury trials move to Tuesdays. Walk-in mitigation hours remain unchanged at the Main Courthouse on Burleson Road.

action.label: Check the new schedule & walk-in hours

developments.title: School support jobs: current application links
developments.summary: Austin ISD’s careers page currently features food service managers, custodians and bus drivers. Saturday’s hiring fair is over; use the district’s application links for current opportunities.

action.label: See jobs & apply through the district

feature.title: Austin Council on October 8: three questions worth following
feature.summary: Housing near Lost Creek, easements for Eubank Tributary work and an ATXFloods contract are pending proposals. Read what each would authorize, what remains unsettled and what to check after the meeting.

action.label: Read the three questions & official records

goodThing.title: A birthday tradition that gives something back
goodThing.summary: Chloe Brown turned 19 at a September 29 campus blood drive. In a Sunday report, she told The Daily Texan why she gives blood on her birthday each year.
